name: RankParse
description: RankParse gives Claude read-only backlink and competitive intelligence for Claude: audit a domain's backlink profile and referring domains, run competitor-gap and domain-overlap analysis to find link opportunities a competitor has that you don't, and check anchor text, link quality, and site health. It also covers domain authority, technical SEO, tech-stack detection, sitemap discovery, and batch domain lookup — all sourced from a processed Common Crawl dataset plus real-time checks, without giving Claude write access to anything. This connector does not include Google Search Console, Google Ads, or outreach tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RankParse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RankParse to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connect.rankparse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RankParse MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RankParse lists 23 MCP tools, including batch_lookup, check_credits, get_anchor_text, get_backlinks, get_competitor_gap, get_crawl_history, get_domain_authority, get_domain_overlap, get_domain_rank, get_link_audit, get_link_intersect, and get_outbound_links.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RankParse?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RankParse in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
RankParse requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RankParse is developed by Abhi Bavishi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
